premium.free_description: Start with the free features and limits shown in the comparison below.
premium.subscribe_description: Activate Premium for one Discord community through Discord. Custom bots require the GmodStore offer.
premium.one_time_description: Activate Premium for one Discord community through GmodStore, with access to the custom bot feature.
premium.faq_answer_1: Premium increases limits and adds the customization options shown in the comparison above. Features marked as in development are not available yet. Custom bots require the GmodStore offer.
premium.faq_question_2: What is the difference between a community and a game server?
premium.faq_answer_2: A community is your Discord server. A game server is a Garry's Mod server connected to it. One Discord community can manage several game servers, within the limits of its offer.
premium.faq_answer_3: Premium-only features become unavailable and free limits apply. Expiry does not erase your saved configuration. You can still disable or remove saved settings that require Premium.
premium.faq_question_4: Can I get a refund or cancel my subscription ?
premium.faq_answer_4: We do not process payments ourselves. We use Discord and GmodStore for payment processing. As such, we redirect you to their respective refund policies for any inquiries regarding refunds or cancellations.
premium.faq_answer_5: Use the Discord offer for a monthly subscription. For a GmodStore purchase, link your Steam account, then use the dashboard to activate the purchase for a community you manage.
premium.faq_question_6: Does Premium cover all my communities?
premium.faq_answer_6: Premium applies to the Discord community for which it is activated. Check each community's offer in its dashboard. Manage the community linked to a GmodStore purchase from your account page.
premium.faq_question_7: Can I move a GmodStore purchase to another community?
premium.faq_answer_7: Unlink the current community from your account page, then activate the purchase for another community you manage. The previous community loses this purchase’s Premium benefits and its custom bot disconnects. Invite the main bot first to keep the integration available, and enter the custom bot token again after reactivation.
premium.faq_answer_8: These features are not available yet, including with Premium. Choose an offer based on the features currently available; no release date is promised here.

dashboard_access_help.requirements: You need Discord Administrator permission and a linked Steam account with a configured game administrator group. Community access requires that group on at least one linked server; a game server dashboard requires it on that server.
dashboard_access_help.exceptions: The Discord server owner and the buyer whose active GmodStore purchase is assigned to this community are exempt from this combined requirement. A purchase assigned to another community does not grant access here. Buyers should link the Steam account used for their purchase and check its associated community in Account.
dashboard_access_help.discord_step: Sign in with the correct Discord account. Ask the community owner to check that it has the Administrator permission.
dashboard_access_help.steam_step: Open Account, then link the Steam account you use on the game server.
dashboard_access_help.game_step_title: Ask an authorized person to assign your game group
dashboard_access_help.game_step: Ask the game server owner to give your Steam account an administrator group in game. Someone who already has dashboard access must include that exact group in Server configuration → Game administrator groups.
dashboard_access_help.sync_step_title: Report the updated group and recheck
dashboard_access_help.sync_step: After the group is assigned, join the game server once, wait a few seconds, then disconnect so the addon reports it. Wait for synchronization, then select Recheck access. You do not need to stay connected to the game.
